overview: Tollgate Cottages is a countryside B&B on Wilmingham Lane, about 0.7 miles inland from Freshwater Bay. Guests have a self-contained suite with two bedrooms, a sitting room and a bathroom, sleeping up to four, along with breakfast and a large garden. There is free off-road parking and secure cycle storage.
surfTripFit: A quiet, private suite under a mile from Freshwater Bay, with off-road parking.
